items.label: 1901年
items.title: 费米诞生
items.text: 恩里科·费米出生于罗马。他用中子轰击多种元素，造出一批新的放射性核素，并发现慢中子更容易引发核反应；后来他领导建成芝加哥一号堆，让链式反应从设想变为可控装置。

sources.fact_quote: for his demonstrations of the existence of new radioactive elements produced by neutron irradiation, and for his related discovery of nuclear reactions brought about by slow neutrons
for his demonstrations of the existence of new radioactive elements produced by neutron irradiation, and for his related discovery of nuclear reactions brought about by slow neutrons

items.label: 1954年
items.title: 欧洲核子研究组织成立
items.text: 欧洲核子研究组织的成立公约生效，实验室由此正式诞生。西欧多国把加速器与粒子束实验集中到同一屋檐下，此后它成为高能物理合作与人才培养的中枢，万维网也在这样的土壤里被发明出来。

sources.fact_quote: The Convention for the Establishment of a European Organization for Nuclear Research and the Financial Protocol annexed thereto, open for signature at Paris from 1 July to 31 December 1953, entered into force on 29  September,  1954.

items.label: 1962年
items.title: 加拿大首颗卫星云雀一号升空
items.text: 加拿大首颗卫星「云雀一号」升空，它由本国团队设计制造，用来探测电离层。卫星用超长天线发射无线电脉冲，由回波反推电子密度的垂直分布，加拿大由此成为世界上第三个自主造出卫星的国家。

sources.date_quote: The original, Canada's first space satellite, was designed to study the ionosphere. It was launched from the Pacific Missile range on September 29, 1962 atop a Thor-Agena vehicle
sources.fact_quote: The original, Canada's first space satellite, was designed to study the ionosphere.

items.label: 2004年
items.title: 图塔蒂斯近距离掠过地球
items.text: 小行星4179图塔蒂斯以约155万公里的距离掠过地球，是该世纪同类大小的已知天体中最近的一次接近。射电望远镜抓住机会做雷达成像，测出它像土豆一样的不规则外形与缓慢翻滚的自转。

sources.date_quote: The Sep. 29, 2004, approach is the closest in this century of any known asteroid at least as large as Toutatis.
sources.fact_quote: The Sep. 29, 2004, approach is the closest in this century of any known asteroid at least as large as Toutatis.

items.label: 2009年
items.title: 萨摩亚8.1级地震与海啸
items.text: 萨摩亚群岛附近海底发生8.1级地震，数分钟后海啸袭击岛屿，在萨摩亚、美属萨摩亚和汤加造成约两百人死亡。灾后野外考察发现，这次海啸由少见的洋壳外侧正断层引发，浪高分布远超预期。

sources.date_quote: The Samoa tsunami of September 29, 2009, was the fifth tsunami studied by U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) field teams in 15 years, and yet it presented many surprises.
sources.fact_quote: The tsunami was generated by a magnitude 8.1 earthquake that occurred about 190 km southwest of American Samoa at 6:48 a.m. Samoa Standard Time.

sources.date_quote: This tsunami was generated by an 8.1 magnitude earthquake near the Samoan Islands on September 29, 2009.
sources.fact_quote: it was very destructive near the earthquake and killed 192 people in Samoa, American Samoa, and Tonga

items.label: 2010年
items.title: 多丝正比室发明人夏帕克去世
items.text: 物理学家乔治·夏帕克去世。他发明并改进多丝正比室，用一排排细丝把带电粒子的径迹转成可读电信号，使探测器能同时定位大量粒子，为后来的高能物理实验和医学成像提供了关键手段。

sources.fact_quote: for his invention and development of particle detectors, in particular the multiwire proportional chamber
for his invention and development of particle detectors, in particular the multiwire proportional chamber
